title: Spring Data, JPA & Hibernate
intro: Spring Data JPA interviews test whether you understand the ORM, not just the repository interface. This module is an elevation arc: it opens with JPA fundamentals (the EntityManager, persistence context, entity states), then Hibernate internals (the session, dirty checking, cascades). Entity relationships and the Spring Data repository layer follow, then transactions (the most-asked topic — propagation, isolation). The problem tier — N+1, query optimization, caching, batch processing — is where senior interviewers land. Migrations and multi-tenancy close the advanced tier, then comparisons and scenario-based questions.
